Use this for an unknown that changes a decision. Start with what you cannot yet answer, why it matters and the smallest useful check.


<details class="template-copy">
<summary>Open the blank copyable template</summary>

Copy this plain-text version into your approved project record. Repeat entry fields as needed and remove prompts that do not apply. The guidance and examples below help you complete it.

```text
Unresolved-questions log

Blank register

ID: Q-001
Question: [ ]
Why it matters: [consequence]
Current evidence: [ ]
Next check: [smallest useful check]
Owner: [ ]
Decision date: [ ]
```

</details>

## Check your record

Review the question by its decision date. When it is answered, link the evidence and resulting decision; when it is not, decide whether to change route or seek help.

## Scenario test

The team cannot answer the question today. The log prevents an unknown from becoming an assumption and gives it a next check.
